findings.title: Cheat sheet misclassifies valid offchain document mutations
findings.description: The plane table correctly says hooks.offchain is where DocumentPlugin mutations belong. The common-rejections list then says any mutating plugin call in hooks.offchain belongs in hooks.onchain. DocumentPlugin.putDocument and updateField are mutating calls and are specifically valid offchain, so the latter advice contradicts the page and can lead agents to generate invalid or semantically incorrect hook placement.
findings.recommendation: Change item 3 to refer specifically to onchain plugin calls, such as TokenPlugin.transfer, appearing in rules or hooks.offchain. Explicitly preserve DocumentPlugin mutations as the supported offchain-hook case.
